resources.string: Log your periods and how you feel. Calore predicts your next period with a range, shows the phase you are in, and gives food tips for each phase. With Plan my week, iron-rich meals come up more in period weeks and magnesium-rich ones before your period. Your calorie target never changes because of your cycle.
Your cycle data stays on this phone. It is never shared with your household, and it is in a backup file only when you make one yourself. You can lock it and delete it at any time.
Not for birth control or for getting pregnant. Not medical advice.
Log the first day of your period to start.
Predictions are paused because of your settings (hormonal contraception, pregnancy, breastfeeding or menopause). Logged bleeding still shows.
Iron-rich food, with something rich in vitamin C such as peppers or citrus, which helps your body take up the iron.

Filling snacks with protein and fibre, such as yoghurt with oats or hummus with vegetables.
Magnesium-rich food: nuts, seeds, legumes and whole grains.

Optional: send weekly summaries for research

If you agree, Calore sends a short summary of your week to our research database every Monday. It helps us understand how people in Czechia eat. We publish only statistics about groups of at least 10 people.
The summary never contains your name, exact dates, or the names of the foods you ate. You choose what is included, you can see every summary, and you can stop and delete your data at any time.
This is optional. Calore works the same whether you take part or not.
Thank you. Taking part in research is only for people aged 18 and older. Calore works the same for you.
